name: ecommerce-microservices
description: Plateforme E-Commerce en architecture Microservices (Node.js, Express, React)

scripts.install:all: npm install && cd services/api-gateway && npm install && cd ../auth-service && npm install && cd ../product-service && npm install && cd ../order-service && npm install && cd ../payment-service && npm install && cd ../../frontend && npm install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n "GATEWAY,AUTH,PRODUCT,ORDER,PAYMENT,FRONTEND" -c "magenta,blue,green,yellow,cyan,red" "npm run start:gateway" "npm run start:auth" "npm run start:product" "npm run start:order" "npm run start:payment" "npm run start:frontend"
